title: Explainability UI Popover
description: Verify clear and understandable natural language explanation rendering for AI insights
precondition: AI generated insights are visible on screen.
test_step_description: Click 'Request Explanation' hyperlink on an active trend item card.
test_step_expected_result: System renders a popup window containing mathematical contribution factors in clear, plain text format.

title: Performance - Massive Dataset SLA
description: Verify system model execution engine generation times under maximum transaction volume
test_step_description: Trigger standard AI insight generation routine across the complete dataset.
test_step_expected_result: Model operations compute prioritization rules fully within the 5-second GDPR system boundary SLA limit parameters.

title: Negative - Corrupted Data Stream
description: Verify model graceful exception routing when analytics data streams arrive corrupted
test_step_description: Pump malformed data frame array structure blocks into the analytics engine input hooks.
test_step_expected_result: System catches parsing execution exception, prevents analytical cluster crash, and flags logging console with 'ERR-ML-DATA-PARSE'.

title: Feedback Loop Update
description: Verify recommendation algorithm adapts dynamically based on user explicit feedback
test_step_description: Submit explicit negative feedback rating tag to active recommendation engine array.
test_step_expected_result: Database logs user rejection tag; future dashboard evaluation matrices systematically down-prioritize similar model recommendations.
